notes: Three routes. The first writes its own chain through Ibn Jurayj, Abu al-Zubayr and Jabir. The second and third converge at «جميعا عن ابن جريج» and close with «بهذا الإسناد مثله», a back_reference to the chain after Ibn Jurayj.
«حدثنيه» and «وحدثناه» open new routes of the same saying (rule 4); no saying keys, since the text carries one saying.
shared_tail is null: the first route writes its own Ibn Jurayj, so one tail would be wrong for it.
